term: restriction to the existing concrete candidate roster
definition: concreteOntic restricts the existing Profile ontology to the subtype of candidates satisfying its concrete predicate, inheriting accessibility, existence and generic causes. concreteSupport separately restricts the same Profile.grounds relation. No causal/grounding identification or existence axiom is introduced.
note: Source-free carrier restriction/composition of the existing Profile and necessarily-underived vocabulary. This introduces no competing metaphysical sense. Concrete is the existing fixed predicate; why it applies to actual beings, the causal meaning of grounds, and the two modal-grounding premises remain OPEN. See docs/notes/ultimate-adequacy-integration-735.md, concrete-underived composition.
